checks.name: 1. Core: clock35 follows CLOCK35.fn, cue35 reaches its hooks and is silent on replays
2. Purse: new households start with ₦6,000 (companion, two players), old saves keep their money
3. Seedling: none on day 1 for a new household; it arrives on day 2 (without the later modules), lazily on plant or load; old households plant on day 1

4. Crop: a watered day adds a stage overnight; watering at stage 2 ripens at once; harvest gives three peppers and resets the pot; the pot marker clears when nothing more is due; stage 2 has flowers; the harvest has its own card
5. Wall-clock bite: 2.2–4.4 s of real time at 5 fps; nibble before bite; dt-only loops still bite; none behind the Menu; one catch cue
6. Act: presses Cast, Reel in, Keep or Cast again on the fishing panels only, 300 ms after a panel change, never in a text field or on any other panel

7. Outdoor seats: armchair and chairs at veranda columns 1, 2 and 6; the walkway, the room cell inside the door and the path to the pot stay clear; the veranda and the pot are reached on foot from inside the flat

8. Paint: the six flat walls and the floor are tagged; buy at Finds (each card’s swatch is its paint’s colour, Adire indigo a deep indigo #3F5B8E), paint at home, undo, reload and a courtyard style keep it; env keeps its own materials
9. Copy: no “two watered nights”; plan details start “Tomorrow morning,” without a lesson price; Tunde’s card, the note and the almanac follow the rules

tunde: Your veranda pot is empty for now. Tomorrow morning I will leave you a seedling. Then we see.
I left a seedling by your pot. Plant it, give it water. Tomorrow we see.

checks.name: 10. Finds never asks for agreement; in a companion household the companion approves in the toast

info.toast: Potted plant is in Build storage. Ola: “Ehen! That is the one.”
info.paint: Ochre limewash is yours. Change the walls and floor from Home. Ola: “That one is correct. The flat will thank us.”

checks.name: 11. Companion shop floor: during the guided shop stage a new household’s companion buys any jollof item it can afford
12. Weekdays: none in item blurbs, the square, occasions, courtyard styles, the copy table, the journal, the noticeboard, Nkechi’s café line or the film-night toast

info.scanned: blurbs, square, occasions, presets, copy table, five journal tabs, noticeboard, toast, memory, talk

method: Actual runtime state and actions in Node with the shipped Three.js and the authored hero; companion households made through dispatch(aiStart); the wall clock stubbed through CLOCK35; checks 3 and 12 include a subset pass that loads the v35 modules only up to tune-v35.js. Nothing rendered here; layout was looked at separately in headless Chromium.
